description: Reference values for rocket_propulsion.aerodynamics slender_body, launch_vehicle and aero_database. Every value was read in this work package from the cited page; 'figure_read' values were read from a printed curve and carry a reading tolerance. 'pdf_page' is the page index of the PDF file read.

tr1048_bodies.locator: Figure 6, printed p. 9 (pdf_page 12): dimensions in inches; text p. 9: 33 1/3-caliber ogival nose, fineness ratios 21.1 (body I) and 13.1 (body II)

tr1048_fig7_body_I.locator: Figure 7(a), printed p. 10 (pdf_page 13): body I, M = 1.98, lift coefficient on base area; dashed curve = potential theory plus calculated viscous cross force; crossflow drag from appendix p. 13: c_dc = 1.2 (low cross-flow Mach), finite-length ratio 0.755
tr1048_fig7_body_I.note: Read at 600 dpi: grid 0/0.5/1.0 at known pixels; dotted potential line at 8 deg read 0.27 against 2 alpha = 0.279. The experimental point is reported as a deviation, not asserted to agree.

tr1307_kwb_figure2.locator: Equation 14 and Figure 2 (slender-body-theory curve), printed pp. 4-5 (pdf_pages 8-9); limits stated in text p. 4 (K_W(B) = 1 at r/s = 0, 2 as r/s -> 1) and p. 6 (K_B(W) = 0 and 2)

nose_normal_force_slope.locator: equation 3-66, printed p. 21 (pdf_page 31): C_N_alpha = 2 A_BN/A_r for a pointed nose

cone_center_of_pressure.locator: equation 3-89, printed p. 29 (pdf_page 39): X_B = l_0 - V_B/A_B; cone V = A l/3

hama_vs_schoenherr.locator: equations 4-3 and 4-4, printed p. 43 (pdf_page 53): Hama agrees with Schoenherr within +-2%

ogive_volume_eq_3_90.note: As read (normalisation d_N A(L)), the right-hand side is exactly 1/4 of the integrated tangent-ogive volume.

sp8035_gust.note: Equation 1 as printed (0.765 dH) is ten times the slope of equation 2 at a2; the implementation uses the tangent slope.

experimental_increment.locator: equations 4 and 5 (pdf_page 4-5): U_EXP = 3 sqrt(n) sigma_rep, n = 2 for tower increments

final_bound.locator: section VII.D, equation 4: UF = 1.05, U_WTcorr = U_bal

net_modeling.locator: section VII.B, equations 2-3: zero if U_rpt > U_DBM
